notes: D1 oracle is docs/southwest-d1/oracle-clash-report.md only. No product lib/cities/southwest/ exists yet. Not generated from GTFS. No stopIds in this file.
Single agency, single direction model (destination + operator) — no two-layer hub problem like East Midlands' Nottingham Station. See direction-model-memo.md.
Modes v1: National Rail heavy rail only. No light rail, no metro, no buses (report line 65, C2/C3 point 10).

National Rail has NO static GTFS publication (Darwin is realtime-only, SOAP API). This is an open product-architecture question already flagged in West of England's and London & South East's packs (same feed, same question) — not resolved in this pack either. See coverageGaps and jim-handoff.md.

Hub lock: Exeter St Davids (EXD). Hub secondary: Plymouth (PLY). Terminus: Penzance (PNZ). No doNotGroup needed at any of the three — GWR-dominated, platforms distinguished by route not operator; CrossCountry through-running is on distinct platforms but the report does not ask for a doNotGroup split (report C2/C3 point 6).

Boundary through-running station is NOT a merge point at D1: Taunton (TAU, West of England boundary). Already documented as a boundary in West of England's pack from the other side; this pack independently reaches the same non-merge conclusion — no contradiction. Flagged for D2 de-dup if/when both regions ship live.

Night Riviera Sleeper (London Paddington–Penzance) is EXCLUDED by board-eligibility verdict: out-reservation (compulsory sleeping-car cabin reservation, cannot walk up and board). Calls at Exeter St Davids, Plymouth, Truro, St Austell, St Erth, Penzance. Consistent with the same service's out-reservation verdict at Paddington in the London & South East National Rail pack. See excludedServices below.
City lands as 'Coming Soon' (status stays planned; there is no separate coming-soon enum value in registry.js) until National Rail is unblocked, same as every other UK National Rail region.

No 'lines' array is provided — National Rail has no printed route/line map to transcribe. This is a flat station list (hub, secondary hub, terminus, through-running-only), not a lines array, matching the West of England / East Midlands National Rail precedent.

License: OGL 2.0 baseline with NRE amendments. Confidence 'unclear' on third-party rider redistribution via the RDM Platform Agreement — same open item as every other UK National Rail region. OPEN ITEM FOR TIM ONLY, do not resolve here.

No docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md exists yet. This pack proceeds on the oracle report alone (plus the two named consistency-check reads) per the dispatch instruction; boundary/exclusion facts here (Taunton, Night Riviera) should be folded into a future docs/united-kingdom-ledger.md rather than rediscovered by the next region.

hub.name: Exeter St Davids
hub.class: hub lock — principal rail terminus for Exeter city; all GWR InterCity and regional services call here. Main interchange between London Paddington services and Southwest corridor (Plymouth-Penzance direction). Through-running point for CrossCountry services via Midlands/Bristol.

secondaryHub.name: Plymouth
secondaryHub.class: hub secondary — Plymouth city station; frequent service to Exeter St Davids (30-60 min), direct service to Penzance via Riviera Line. Regional connections north to Exeter; served by GWR and CrossCountry. Largest passenger station in southwest region after Exeter.

terminus.name: Penzance
terminus.class: terminus — westernmost and southernmost station on National Rail network; terminus of Cornish Main Line. GWR regional/InterCity terminus. Night Riviera Sleeper also terminates here but is EXCLUDED (out-reservation, see excludedServices).

throughRunningOnly.name: Taunton
throughRunningOnly.class: through-running only, boundary to West of England region — not a merge. GWR and CrossCountry services cross into West of England region (Bristol/Bath/London Paddington direction) at this point. De-duplicate at D2 if West of England region enters the app. Already documented from the other side in docs/west-of-england-d1/published-network.json — no contradiction.

throughRunningOnly.name: Newton Abbot
throughRunningOnly.class: through-running only (South West Main Line). GWR and CrossCountry services continue south to Plymouth. No through-running to adjacent regions.

throughRunningOnly.name: Totnes
throughRunningOnly.class: through-running only (Riviera Line branch). GWR regional services continue south to Plymouth. No through-running to adjacent regions.

throughRunningOnly.name: Truro
throughRunningOnly.class: intermediate stop (Cornish Main Line, Truro branch). GWR services call between Exeter and Penzance. No through-running to adjacent regions.

throughRunningOnly.name: St Austell
throughRunningOnly.class: intermediate stop between Truro and Penzance (Cornish Main Line, St Austell branch). No through-running to adjacent regions.

throughRunningOnly.name: St Erth
throughRunningOnly.class: penultimate station before Penzance terminus (Cornish Main Line, St Erth branch). No through-running to adjacent regions.
